verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a distinct Open Source self-hosted bundle that runs the same memory engine as the Platform, deployable via Docker with REST API, dashboard, per-user API keys, and audit log, giving full ownership of stack and data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of self-hosting (all evidence is first-party docs) and details on feature parity limits (e.g., graph memory) between Platform and self-hosted version.
